title: Electricity Billing Complaint
content: A consumer may use the relevant official electricity complaint mechanism to raise a billing-related complaint. The applicable procedure and authority should be verified against the current official source before providing instructions.

title: High Electricity Bill
content: A consumer who believes an electricity bill is incorrect should first review the bill details and use the applicable official complaint or customer-service channel. Specific procedures, deadlines, fees, and responsible offices must be confirmed from the current official source.

title: Distribution Company Services
content: Electricity consumers normally interact with the relevant distribution company for customer-service matters. The responsible distribution company depends on the consumer's service area and should be identified before giving jurisdiction-specific instructions.
